title: Fig in the Gap
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 2 — Learning — Phase 2: new sounds h, b, f, ff
note_for_grown_ups: Still only 12 sounds taught, so every sentence here is built from a tiny word pool — sounding out should feel achievable rather than a struggle at this stage.

pages.illustration: Fig the green caterpillar sitting on a leaf on a puddle path, sky still bright.
Rain beginning to fall, drops landing in puddles along the path near Fig.
Fig the caterpillar getting wet in the rain, looking unhappy, puddles forming around him.
Fig the caterpillar sitting inside a dry gap in an old log beside the puddle path, rain falling outside it.
Fig the caterpillar curled up asleep inside the dry log gap, snug and dry.
Close view of rain still falling steadily into the puddles outside the log gap.

pages.text: Fig did nap. Fig is not sad.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar waking up inside the dry gap as the rain stops and sun returns, looking content.
